_comment: CoroNav evaluation protocol. Values match the final manuscript design (Methods 2.1-2.6). Changing them makes new runs non-comparable with the manuscript's design; it does not change any reported result.
_paper: Vessel overlay slows vision-language-model guidewire navigation in simulated coronary anatomies (manuscript in submission)
_see_also: PROTOCOL.md (human-readable protocol and change history); docs/MANUSCRIPT_CONCORDANCE.md (audit, open issues)

a2.name: ASOCA Normal_12
a2.source: ASOCA challenge (NOT bundled — register at https://asoca.grand-challenge.org/)
a2._step_budget_note: Manuscript 2.6: 120 steps in both A2 arms. Protocol v1.0 of this repository recorded 45 (wire-only) and 62 (overlay); that contradiction is unresolved — see docs/MANUSCRIPT_CONCORDANCE.md, issue U3.

a3.name: ASOCA Normal_5 (constant-radius 2.5 mm tube along patient centerline)
a3.exclusion_reason: Not a patient-derived lumen (every branch is a generated 2.5 mm tube) and contact-solver convergence was inadequate. Excluded on physical validity (manuscript 2.2); supports no manuscript claim. Kept only so archived runs can be re-inspected.
a3.source: ASOCA challenge (NOT bundled — register at https://asoca.grand-challenge.org/)

operator.decoding: stochastic and unseeded; seeds fix the simulator reset only
operator.failed_call: not retried or skipped; a null action is executed and consumes the step

open_loop_control.note: Receives no image and no state. Establishes solvability; no hypothesis test against an operator arm.

primary.name: navigation_efficiency
primary.description: Steps to target (tip within 5 mm of target within the step limit), analysed over ALL episodes without conditioning on success.
primary.analysis_a1: worst-rank imputation + Wilcoxon signed-rank; Finkelstein-Schoenfeld win ratio with bootstrap CI; log-rank with failures censored at the step limit
primary.analysis_a2: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank with Hodges-Lehmann estimate (every episode succeeded)

secondary.name: f_rot_LM
secondary.description: Left-main-phase rotation-movement fraction: sum of |per-step change in tip-to-target distance| on rotate-intent steps, divided by the same sum over all steps, both restricted to valid steps whose post-step tip is classified as left_main. Dimensionless, in [0, 1]. Despite the code name, it is not in millimetres.
secondary.analysis: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank (primary) with Holm correction over the {A1, A2} family; unpaired Mann-Whitney U as sensitivity

endpoints.hierarchy_note: The endpoint hierarchy was revised after corrected results were known; this is disclosed as a post hoc decision in the manuscript.

exclusion_criteria: Episodes with zero valid operator actions are excluded as non-attempts. Partial-failure episodes are included.

superseded_v1._comment: Protocol v1.0 values as originally released in this repository. Retained for the record only. Results generated under these values are not manuscript results.
superseded_v1.primary_metric: lm_rot_mm, median per episode, two-sided Mann-Whitney U
